stories.title: Dozens of migrants taken to Dover after more than 30 hours at sea

en.title: Dozens of migrants taken to Dover after more than 30 hours at sea
en.summary: A group of migrants rescued after spending over 30 hours at sea were brought to Dover. Protesters had previously gathered in Gosport in response to reports about where the boat would be taken.

en.title: Iran-US war latest: Trump says meeting with Iranian delegation went well after his threat to annihilate country
en.summary: Trump described a three-hour meeting between his representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff with Iranian officials as very good.

en.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials from both countries meet on sidelines
en.summary: During a UN address, the US president raised the possibility of reaching a peace agreement with Iran or pursuing severe military action. Officials from both nations held discussions at the UN gathering.

stories.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June as Trump threatens ‘annihilation’

en.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June as Trump threatens 'annihilation'
en.summary: US representatives held talks with Iranian delegates at the UN while oil prices remained stable. The president indicated the discussions were productive despite earlier threats.

en.title: Burnham will review Chagos deal after Trump calls it 'terrible'
en.summary: A deal concerning the Chagos Islands faces review following criticism from the US president, who described it as ridiculous. The president praised the relevant official as a skilled businessperson.

stories.title: Children as young as 13 receiving treatment for ‘ketamine bladder’, new study reveals

en.title: Children as young as 13 receiving treatment for 'ketamine bladder', new study reveals
en.summary: A study of patients at a Liverpool service found that children as young as 13 are receiving treatment for ketamine-related bladder damage, with the majority being girls from disadvantaged areas.

stories.title: New simple urine and fluid test could transform womb cancer diagnosis

en.title: New simple urine and fluid test could transform womb cancer diagnosis
en.summary: A new diagnostic test using urine and fluid samples may improve detection of womb cancer, which affects around 10,200 women annually in the UK.

stories.title: Children as young as 13 being referred to UK hospital suffering from ‘ketamine bladder’

en.title: Children as young as 13 being referred to UK hospital suffering from 'ketamine bladder'
en.summary: The UK's first specialist clinic for ketamine-related bladder disease opened at Alder Hey hospital in Liverpool, treating young people whose sustained ketamine use causes severe chronic bladder problems.

stories.title: UK doctors develop non-invasive test for womb cancer in women bleeding after menopause

en.title: UK doctors develop non-invasive test for womb cancer in women bleeding after menopause
en.summary: UK doctors created a non-invasive test using urine and vaginal fluid samples that could help identify womb cancer in menopausal women and reduce the need for invasive procedures.

en.title: Trump says he can do business with Burnham but criticises 'terrible' Chagos deal
en.summary: Trump expressed willingness to work with the UK leadership while objecting to a proposed arrangement involving the Chagos Islands, Mauritius, and a military base lease arrangement.

stories.title: Trump praises relations with Burnham despite tensions over AI and Iran

en.title: Trump praises relations with Burnham despite tensions over AI and Iran
en.summary: US President Trump met with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham at the UN assembly, praising him as a natural businessperson despite existing disagreements between the countries on artificial intelligence regulation, the Chagos islands, and Iran.
